plugins.name: market-research-skills
plugins.description: Claude Skills collection for market research, equity research, and investment analysis. Currently includes: verifying (fact-check against primary sources), topic-brief (single-piece HTML briefing generator), analyst-research (3-mode research workflow: light 4-5p memo / medium 12-15p topic analysis, 6-10 charts / heavy flagship 30-40p, 15k+ words, 25-35+ charts). | 市场研究 / 投研 / 行业分析 Claude Skills 合集。当前包含：verifying（信息核实）、topic-brief（主题观察简报生成器）、analyst-research（三档研究工作流：light 4-5 页备忘 / medium 12-15 页主题分析、6-10 图 / heavy 30-40 页、1.5 万字+、25-35+ 图）。
